title: On hyperinvariant subspaces of operators containing unilateral shifts
summary: The hyperinvariant subspace problem for Hilbert space operators $T$ containing a unilateral shift is addressed. The discussion is based on a similarity model of $T$, which is an operator-matrix $\widehat T= [T_{i,j}]_3$ where $T_{1,1}$ is the simple unilateral shift $S$ and $T_{3,3}$ is a cyclic diagonal operator $D$. The existence of $D$ is established by the technique resulting almost invariant half-spaces in \cite{APTT}; see also \cite{Tc} and \cite{HP}.
